the solution is supersaturated against Hematite (SI +4.1). Matching solids exist in this lab's registry but were not offered in this aqueous equilibrium problem; phase selection, oxidation-state restrictions, or another model's ownership can exclude them. Their formation and its timescale are not predicted by these saturation indices
Fe(OH)2.7Cl.3 (SI +2.4) have reported saturation indices but no phase definition in the selected wateq4f diagnostic index; their phase type and exclusion reason cannot be classified
